name: NEXUS Competitive Benchmark Rubric
description: Weighted scoring rubric to compare NEXUS AI against Manus, browser-use, OpenManus, AgenticSeek, Presenton, and Gamma/Tome-style presentation tools. Scores are 1-10 per category. Weighted_total = sum(weight * score) / 10. Maximum weighted_total = 100.

categories.description: Generated decks conform to the canonical 7-layout schema with valid normalized payloads and pass deck_quality checks.
evidence_required: live generation pinned to canonical layouts only

categories.description: Typography, spacing, hierarchy, premium feel for all 7 layouts on web and exports.
evidence_required: screenshot diff suite (does not exist yet)

categories.description: PPTX and PDF exports preserve layout, content, and ordering relative to the on-screen renderer.
evidence_required: renderer↔export contract test (does not exist yet)

categories.description: Source/citation grounding correctness: deck-level and slide-level today; claim-level required for full score.
evidence_required: claim-level citation mapping (does not exist yet)
live source-fact-check eval (does not exist yet)

categories.description: Tool-calling runtime can plan, browse, search, and execute steps end-to-end with safety guardrails.
evidence_required: live browser-use parity eval (does not exist yet)

categories.description: Backend tests green, migrations reversible, no flaky behavior across runs.
evidence_required: no flaky tests across 3 consecutive runs (not yet measured)

categories.description: Auth on internal routes, rate limits, per-user quotas, secrets management, audit logging.
evidence_required: SSE step streaming (does not exist yet)

competitors.label: Manus (target)
competitors.notes: Reference for end-to-end autonomous agent + deck-quality user experience.

competitors.label: browser-use
competitors.notes: Reference for browser tool autonomy and DOM-action accuracy.

competitors.label: OpenManus
competitors.notes: Reference for general-purpose tool-calling agent loop architecture.

competitors.label: Gamma / Tome
competitors.notes: Reference for visual quality, layout breadth, and export polish.

competitors.label: Presenton
competitors.notes: Open-source (Apache 2.0) presentation generator with FastAPI + Next.js + Electron desktop, BYOK across OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/Ollama, SSE slide streaming, async-with-status generation, PPTX/PDF ingestion, MCP server, and ~100 backend tests. Stronger than NEXUS today on import surface, provider breadth, async/SSE, MCP, and test count; weaker reference for live AI-accuracy or pixel-visual measurement (no pixel-diff visual regression).
